summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of PhishProof gamified scam detection app. All 15 user stories tested successfully with core game mechanics, UI/UX, and localStorage persistence working properly.
passed_tests: US1: Welcome page loads <3s with Kavach mascot and Start Training button
US1: Name input works, navigation to skill map successful
US2: Skill map shows 6 categories with 3 lessons each, first lesson unlocked
US2: Clicking sms-1 navigates to /lesson/sms-1 and loads scenario
US3: Correct answer triggers progression to next round with animations
US4: Wrong answer triggers red feedback, heart loss, navigation to breakdown
US4: Breakdown shows scam/legit header, annotated scenario, 3 teaching cards
US5: Continue from breakdown returns to lesson and resumes correctly
US6: Results page shows stars (0-3), animated XP counter, accuracy %, navigation buttons
US7: Daily Missions drawer opens from skill map with 3 missions
US8: GameHUD visible with hearts (5), XP bar, streak, sound toggle, back button
US9: Scenario renderers display realistic device frames (SMS, UPI, etc.)
US10: TrueOrFalse shows statement with TRUE/FALSE buttons
US11: WhatWouldYouDo shows 4 option cards (A, B, C, D)
US12: Progress persists via localStorage - XP, badges, streak survive reload
US13: Sound toggle changes icon (Volume2 ↔ VolumeX)
US14: Back button returns to skill map
US15: Welcome page statistics (43% teens, 300% UPI, 28% OTP) visible
Locked lesson states working - UPI lessons locked until SMS complete
Badge unlock system working with 'First Blood' badge
Question type variety - LegitOrScam, TrueOrFalse, WhatWouldYouDo, SpotTheFlag
Breakdown teaching content with red flags and action advice
Glass morphism UI effects and animated backgrounds working
Mobile-first responsive design (420x900 viewport) working properly
